title.zh: 股票与量化研究工具链

problem.zh: 把财务筛选、共识排序和含成本回测串成可复核的研究流程。
problem.en: Connect financial screening, consensus ranking and cost-aware backtest arithmetic.

inputs.zh: 内置合成 CSV；实际研究另行准备财务和行情数据。
inputs.en: Bundled synthetic CSVs; real research needs separately prepared market and financial data.

outputs.zh: REPORT.md、排名 CSV、持仓、成本与输入哈希。
outputs.en: REPORT.md, rank CSVs, holdings, costs and input hashes.

contribution.zh: 原创 Skills 与脚本，含多框架合成和回测核算；第三方合集另有来源说明。
contribution.en: Original Skills and scripts for consensus and backtest arithmetic; third-party collections retain attribution.

environment.en: Python 3.11+ with NumPy and pandas for the demo.

limits.zh: 演示是两个独立合成场景；计算通过不代表投资效果。
limits.en: Two independent synthetic scenarios; successful arithmetic does not establish investment performance.

expected.zh: 终端打印 PASS 和新的 output/demo/run-…/REPORT.md 路径。
expected.en: The terminal prints PASS and a new output/demo/run-…/REPORT.md path.

problem.zh: 让安全审查保留源码位置、有限流向证据和人工复核结论。
problem.en: Keep source locations, bounded flow evidence and human decisions together.

inputs.zh: 本地源码、公开仓库快照或内置 demo-project。
inputs.en: Local source, public repository snapshots or the bundled demo-project.

outputs.zh: 审查信号、覆盖情况与 HTML / SARIF 等报告。
outputs.en: Review signals, coverage information and HTML / SARIF reports.

contribution.zh: 基于 xss-audit 方法扩展扫描引擎、AST 分析、桌面与浏览器复核界面。
contribution.en: Extend the xss-audit playbook with a scanner, AST analysis and desktop/browser review interfaces.

environment.zh: 源码 Python 3.11+；Windows 便携包与浏览器版另有入口。
environment.en: Python 3.11+ for source; separate Windows portable and browser entrypoints.

limits.zh: 信号需人工确认；浏览器和桌面覆盖不同，源码复验不等于重测发布包。
limits.en: Signals need human confirmation. Browser/desktop coverage differs; source checks do not revalidate published binaries.

expected.zh: 生成 demo-review.html，列出合成示例的审查信号及覆盖情况。只扫描示例，不执行其源码。
expected.en: demo-review.html lists review signals and coverage for the synthetic fixture. Scan it without executing its source.

problem.zh: 从编码 Agent 的本地日志查看 token、工具调用和成本估算。
problem.en: Inspect tokens, tool calls and estimated costs from local coding-agent logs.

inputs.zh: 指定目录的受支持日志；首次运行使用公开合成样本。
inputs.en: Supported logs in an explicit directory; use the public synthetic fixture first.

outputs.zh: 终端汇总或可解析的 JSON。

contribution.zh: 多种日志解析器、会话与工具统计、终端及 JSON 输出。
contribution.en: Agent log parsers, session/tool statistics and terminal/JSON output.

environment.zh: Node.js 18+、npm；源码安装需要包源访问。
environment.en: Node.js 18+ and npm; dependency installation needs registry access.

limits.zh: 日志格式覆盖有限；价格使用内置估算，不是账单。源码修复未发布到 npm。
limits.en: Log-format coverage is limited. Built-in price estimates are not invoices. Source fixes are not published to npm.

expected.zh: 输出一个 session 为 synthetic-demo 的 JSON 对象；不会读取个人会话。
expected.en: Print one JSON object with session synthetic-demo without reading personal sessions.

title.zh: 论文 PDF 中文排版流程

problem.zh: 在保留论文版面坐标的前提下，把已有中文译文写回 PDF 并检查。
problem.en: Write supplied Chinese translations into the paper's PDF coordinates and inspect the result.

inputs.zh: 有文本层的 PDF、逐段译文 JSON 与中文字体。
inputs.en: A text-layer PDF, translated segment JSON and Chinese fonts.

outputs.zh: 中文 PDF、可复跑的译文工程和五项版面检查。
outputs.en: A Chinese PDF, reproducible translation inputs and five layout checks.

contribution.zh: 整理六阶段 Skill、提取/回写/质检脚本和共享输入校验。
contribution.en: A six-stage Skill, extraction/build/QA scripts and shared input validation.

environment.en: Python 3.11+, PyMuPDF, fonttools and available Chinese fonts.

limits.zh: 脚本不自动生成译文；扫描件需先 OCR，合成自检不代表真实论文翻译质量。
limits.en: Scripts do not generate translations. Scans need OCR; a synthetic check does not validate real-paper translation quality.

expected.zh: 合成 PDF 完成提取、写入与质检，五项问题数为 0；临时文件自动清理。
expected.en: The synthetic PDF passes extraction, build and QA with five zero issue counts; temporary files are cleaned up.

title.zh: 已有 PPTX 批量改版

problem.zh: 把字号、底色、标题与院标调整变成可复跑的课件改版流程。
problem.en: Turn font, background, title and logo changes into a repeatable slide workflow.

inputs.zh: 已有 PPTX 和按课件调整的配置；首次运行用合成单页。
inputs.en: An existing PPTX with deck-specific configuration; begin with a synthetic slide.

outputs.zh: 分版本 PPTX、字号映射和扫描 JSON；完整流程另含实测与审计。
outputs.en: Versioned PPTX files, font-size mappings and scan JSON; the full workflow adds measurement and audit.

contribution.zh: 课件改版 Skill、批处理脚本、PowerPoint 实测回退与输出路径保护。
contribution.en: A slide workflow, batch scripts, PowerPoint measurement/fallback and output-path guards.

environment.zh: 基础演示只需 Python 3.10+ 与 python-pptx；实测/导出需 Windows PowerPoint。
environment.en: The basic demo needs Python 3.10+ and python-pptx; measurement/export needs Windows PowerPoint.

limits.zh: 无 Office 演示只验证扫描和字号映射，不证明排版可交付；fit 未绑定课件指纹。
limits.en: The Office-free demo checks scanning and size mapping, not deliverable layout. Fit data is not bound to a deck fingerprint.

expected.zh: 打印 PASS 和新的 _build/demo-… 目录，含 source.pptx、enlarged.pptx、scan.json、size_map.json。
expected.en: Print PASS and a new _build/demo-… directory with source.pptx, enlarged.pptx, scan.json and size_map.json.

title.zh: 期货分板块研究工作台

problem.zh: 在共同区间、信息时点与样本覆盖明确的条件下比较产业板块。
problem.en: Compare sectors with explicit common windows, information cutoffs and sample coverage.

inputs.zh: 内置合成配置，或用户准备并注明来源的市场与产业数据。
inputs.en: Bundled synthetic configuration or user-supplied, source-labelled market and industry data.

outputs.zh: 中英文 HTML / Markdown、JSON、冻结输入与 SHA-256 清单。
outputs.en: English/Chinese HTML and Markdown, JSON, frozen inputs and SHA-256 manifests.

contribution.zh: 八个专项 Skills 的统一工作台、数据契约、证据与风险核算工具。
contribution.en: A shared desk for eight specialist Skills, data contracts, evidence handling and risk arithmetic.

environment.zh: Python 3.10+；基础离线命令只用标准库。
environment.en: Python 3.10+; base offline commands use the standard library.

limits.zh: 样例使用合成数据与虚构规则；研究计算不构成已验证交易策略。
limits.en: Fixtures use synthetic data and fictional rules; research calculations are not validated trading strategies.

expected.zh: 新输出目录包含中英文报告、JSON 和可校验的输入/输出清单。
expected.en: A new output directory contains bilingual reports, JSON and verifiable input/output manifests.
